doc.title: Nancy Wilson interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, November 16, 1995

title: Singing, not show business
summary: She says she wants to sing, not be in show business, and chose to be herself.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Looking back: no regrets, what it all meant

blocks.x: Well it sounds like your musical and career instincts were really well formed in your youth, so that’s served you well.
When someone would attempt to tell you —

Well I just felt that there has to be another way to do show business. I mean if you’re going to do it — I want to sing, I don’t want to be in show business. So I’ve always made that distinction. There is a difference and you can’t do it both ways. You can either be caught up in it and become totally involved and allow it to be the master, or you can say this is me. I have to do it this way in order to maintain, to be sane, to be myself. And I preferred, I chose to be me, rather than to be somebody else.
